title: Player Stuck on Staircase Step Edge Requiring Triple Jump Escape
explanation: At frames 1461 and 1639, entering the stair step at coordinates (5433, 560) (tile [68, 7]) caused horizontal movement to seize. Traced to Player.gd:L141-L155 where is_stair_stuck zeroes horizontal velocity until 3 jump inputs are pressed, violating fluid platform movement contracts.
